about_the_game:
A program to expand your English vocabulary
This app helps you grow your vocabulary through passive learning using an overlay, along with flashcard-style active practice.

Overlay
It’s simple: for easier and more passive learning, you can place an overlay anywhere on your screen. At set intervals, it shows the words you're studying. While gaming or working, you’ll glance at them now and then — and memorize them over time.

Practice
Then comes the word training. You get +1 for a correct answer and -1 for an incorrect one. When a word reaches +5, it’s considered learned and is no longer shown in training.

Libraries
All words are grouped into categories like “Travel”, “Home”, “Family”, and so on. Each category contains many words. To simplify learning, you can select a category and generate a specific number of words into a separate “Training Set”. Progress made in training is also saved back to the main library.

You can also create your own word libraries or add new words to existing ones.

Main Features:

  • Progress — Track your progress with learned words and those needing review.

  • Practice — Practice with flashcards that require answers. Train regularly and watch your progress grow.

  • Overlay — Learn words passively while gaming, working, or relaxing.

  • Library — A library of over 3000 words organized into categories.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (x64)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or NVIDIA GeForce GT 710 / AMD Radeon HD 5450
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Learn English passively — even while gaming or working! An overlay displays the words you’re learning right on top of games or any other apps, allowing you to study the language even during matches, quests, or work. Go through interactive flashcards, improve your vocabulary, and track your progress.
